name: Avatar
description: An accessible avatar with image plus deterministic initials fallback, a presence status dot, and an overlapping avatar group that collapses extras into a +N chip.
usage: Import Avatar (default) and AvatarGroup (named) from Avatar.tsx. Render <Avatar name="Salty Code" src="/me.jpg" status="online" size="lg" />; if src is missing or fails to load it shows colored initials. Render <AvatarGroup avatars={[{name, src, status}, ...]} max={4} /> for an overlapping stack with a +N overflow chip.
